calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS period
)
SELECT cs.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900                         -- stores only: no web, no training store
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag                -- staff purchases are out of ATV
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY atv DESC;

calls.statement:
-- Check the control total for the period
SELECT SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS control_total
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'
  AND r.store_id < 900;

-- Calculate staff purchases and test articles net sales for the period
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS period
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS staff_purchases_net_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS test_articles_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.period;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS period
)
SELECT cs.format,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS average_basket_value
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900                         -- stores only: no web, no training store
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag                -- staff purchases are out of ATV
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY average_basket_value DESC;
